verdict.rationale: Delegation to third parties (mandates, powers of attorney, representative roles, non-delegable signatures) is a fair question for an IP office's filing services, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only lists filing pages, databases, guidelines and support offers. None of it mentions authorization forms, representative roles, or which signatures must stay personal.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, exactly what a third party may and may not do on my behalf is published — the authorization forms, the roles, and which signatures stay personal
